dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Hey! Here to survey the aftermath of the "battle" last night, hunter?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Figured that since Seamus and Frederica went back and Lohen and Mika are out, nobody'd find me...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Looks like I can't get too complacent! My counter-recon skills are gonna need some work.

choices.text: Bring it on, I'm always ready.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Haha... Well, that's enough rest. Now, time to sort out this lot!

choices.text: Finish your work before practicing those skills, okay?
